text.tspan: Rain cover, underwriting and the live
dashboard, on a 3D glass stage that
leans with the pointer. Sign in with
email, Google or a browser wallet.
Quote, buy and check a guarantee over
plain HTTPS and JSON. Five endpoints;
purchases are signed by a policy-limited
Eight slides, each a card on the
inside of a sphere. /partner shows a
remittance app adding a guarantee to
its checkout with one API call.
